hints.tr: Tek bir değerin olasılığı kesikli dağılımda `pmf`.
hints.en: The probability of a single value in a discrete distribution is `pmf`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from scipy import stats


def chance_exactly(n, p, k):
    return round(float(stats.binom(n, p).pmf(k)), 4)


print(chance_exactly(20, 0.114, 2))
print(chance_exactly(10, 0.5, 5))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
from scipy import stats


def chance_exactly(n, p, k):
    return round(float(stats.binom(n, p).pmf(k)), 4)


print(chance_exactly(20, 0.114, 2))
print(chance_exactly(10, 0.5, 5))
```
